title: A Tracked Vehicle and Its Slip: The Thrust a Track Gets From Soil, the Slip It Costs, and What a Little More Slip on One Side Does to a Straight Line

artifact.note: the thrust a track gets from soil as a function of its slip (the Janosi-Hanamoto shear curve), the slip needed for a thrust, the resistance to a pivot of a track with an even pressure along it, and a tracked drive whose two tracks slip by different amounts
